code='''def transform(grid):\n    # Patterned framed object is copied into empty frames of the same interior size; retain source.\n    import numpy as np\n    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])\n    # identify rectangular frames by bounding boxes of each nonzero color\n    from collections import defaultdict\n    cells=defaultdict(list)\n    for r in range(H):\n      for c in range(W):\n        if g[r][c]: cells[g[r][c]].append((r,c))\n    boxes={}\n    for col,pts in cells.items():\n      rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]; boxes[col]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))\n    # source has nonzero interior, take that mask\n    source=None\n    for col,(a,b,c,d) in boxes.items():\n      mask=[[g[r][x]==col for x in range(c+1,d)] for r in range(a+1,b)]\n      if any(map(any,mask)): source=(col,a,b,c,d,mask); break\n    if source is None:return g\n    scol,a,b,c,d,mask=source; sh=len(mask); sw=len(mask[0]) if mask else 0\n    for col,(u,v,x,y) in boxes.items():\n      if col==scol: continue\n      ih=v-u-1; iw=y-x-1\n      if ih==sh and iw==sw:\n        for i in range(ih):\n          for j in range(iw): g[u+1+i][x+1+j]=col if mask[i][j] else 0\n    return g\n'''
